[SWS_DM_00984] Return of cancellation status
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04167
⌈
A call to
ara::diag::CancellationHandler::IsCanceled
shall return false
if the corresponding
Diagnostic Conversation
is not canceled within its cur-
rent processing state. On Cancellation of this
Diagnostic Conversation ara::
diag::CancellationHandler::IsCanceled
shall return true until the
ara::
diag::CancellationHandler
is destructed.
⌋
